name: sk-text
purpose: General-purpose text component for body content, supporting copy, and emphasized introductory text.

do: Use lg for lead or emphasized introductory text.
Use md for standard body content.
Use sm for supporting or secondary body text.
Allow typography to adapt responsively according to the design tokens.
dont: Do not use as a replacement for captions or metadata.
Do not use text size to create semantic heading hierarchy.

code.example: <sk-text size="md">A Japanese music archive exploring sound, design and culture.</sk-text>
